verification.method: scripts/verify/canada.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100 (all table years), rank, share, growth 2022/2023/2026, change, per day, density, land area and land-area rank
Fastest G7 growth in 2026 and lowest density among countries over 30 million (also build checks)
Births, deaths, natural change, net migration 2026 and migration share; record net migration (2022); more deaths than births from 2032
Fertility 2026 vs US, peak (1959), below 2.1 from 1972; median age 1970/2026/2050 and gap with the US; life expectancy
Title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 76 of 76 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
